## Findings

### Anti-patterns

- Zone pin for "packages/hench/src/store/json.ts" → "hench" skipped: the file is not present in any detected zone (out of scope or unzoned). [info]
- Zone pin target "rex-prd-engine" did not form this analysis run — 12 pin(s) skipped and those files fell back to their Louvain zone. Single-target consolidations to "rex-prd-engine" are non-deterministic until it is a stable anchor. Skipped: packages/rex/src/analyze/batch-types.ts, packages/rex/src/cli/commands/fix.ts, packages/rex/src/core/keywords.ts, packages/rex/src/core/tree.ts, packages/rex/src/core/verify.ts, packages/rex/src/schema/index.ts, packages/rex/src/schema/levels.ts, packages/rex/src/schema/v1.ts, +4 more. [warning]
- Fixture directories (tests/fixtures/**, packages/*/tests/fixtures/**) and .claude/ are analysed as real zones, which skews the language detection, the zone-size statistics and the cycle counts. Exclude them, or give them an infrastructure/fixture zone type that is left out of the structural metrics. [info]
- Gateway-archetype files exist outside the documented gateway inventory (web hub/exec-gateway.ts). Add a policy assertion that every file sourcevision classifies as a gateway appears in docs/architecture/gateways.md, so undocumented gateways fail CI instead of drifting silently. [warning]
- Pack golden maintenance is duplicated (lang-runtime/scripts and sourcevision/scripts each have an update-pack-goldens.mjs), and the sourcevision copy is placed in the lang-terraform zone. Pack maintenance tooling has no clear owner. Consolidate it into lang-runtime, which already owns the build-grammars tooling for packs. [warning]
- The production-imported-only-by-tests detector does not model the 'loaded, never imported' packs tier. Every runtime-loaded language pack entry will be reported as dead or missing a caller, which erodes trust in that finding class. Pack entries resolved through src/language/pack-loader.ts should count as having a runtime caller. [warning]
- Zone pins and guidance target ids that this run no longer emits (web-shared, rex-prd-engine, hench-token-usage, rex-unit, web-sv-view-tests). Re-point the pins at the ids the analyser emits now, or add a pin validation that fails when a target zone never forms, so the documented zones and the analysed ones do not drift silently. [warning]
- tests-2 is a second overflow zone with a numeric suffix (13 files), alongside web-viewer-2. Pin it to a named test zone so its id stays the same between analyses. [info]
- God function: Graph in packages/web/src/viewer/views/graph.ts calls 245 unique functions — consider decomposing into smaller, focused functions [critical]
- God function: cliLoop in packages/hench/src/agent/lifecycle/cli-loop.ts calls 88 unique functions — consider decomposing into smaller, focused functions [warning]
- ... and 47 more

### Patterns

- Gateway/barrel files that are supposed to be re-export-only (viewer/api.ts) participate in import cycles; a policy assertion that gateway modules import only their declared sources (types.ts, route-state.ts for api.ts) would catch this class of regression. [warning]
- CLI command handlers (cli/commands/chunked-review.ts, chunked-review-state.ts, fix.ts, modification-intent.ts) share a zone with domain modules (analyze/batch-types.ts, fix/tree.ts), contradicting the rex-satellite 'CLI-only content' policy; domain logic co-clustered with these handlers should move behind src/core/ or src/fix/ and be imported, not co-located. [warning] (rex)
- Pin packages/web/src/shared/*, packages/web/src/hub/request-guard.ts and packages/web/src/cli/index.ts out of web-viewer (to web-shared, web-hub and web respectively) so zone metrics reflect the documented web layering. [warning] (web-viewer)
- Pin packages/web/src/schema/v1.ts to web-shared (or a named web-schema zone) in .n-dx.json; as a single-file overflow zone it hides that both web-server and web-viewer depend on it as a shared contract. [info] (web-viewer-2)

### Relationships

- Test zones import production source across package boundaries (tests-web-unit → rex schema/v1.ts) without passing through the consuming package's gateway; domain-isolation.test.js gateway enforcement covers src/ only, leaving test-side cross-package coupling unaudited. [warning]
- Tightly coupled modules: packages/hench/src/agent/lifecycle/shared.ts and packages/hench/src/types/output.ts — 141 cross-file calls (unidirectional). Consider extracting shared interface or merging [info]
- packages/rex/src/schema/v1.ts is imported by tests-web-unit — web-package tests reach directly into rex source rather than through packages/web/src/server/rex-gateway.ts, so a rex schema change can break web tests without touching the gateway surface the policy suites audit. [warning] (rex-cli)
- hooks/index.ts barrel is the common node in the 4-, 6- and 7-file cycles (use-prd-actions → task-detail → task-start-control → start-task-button → prepare-task-modal/queued-notice → hooks/index.ts). Components importing the hooks barrel instead of the specific hook leaf re-enter use-prd-actions; importing leaf hooks in those components breaks all three cycles. [critical] (web-viewer)
- packages/web/src/viewer/api.ts — documented as a re-export-only inbound contract over types.ts and route-state.ts — participates in cycles through components/index.ts (top-nav→guide, bottom-bar, page-title, project-context). The gateway imports the components barrel, so any component consuming api.ts closes a loop; api.ts should not depend on components/. [critical] (web-viewer)

### Observations

- Isolated files — no import edges between 2 files, cohesion is unmeasurable (reported as 0) [info] (.claude)
- 41 entry points — wide API surface, consider consolidating exports [info] (core)
- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (core)
- 27 circular dependency chains detected — see imports.json for details [warning]
- Bidirectional coupling: "rex" ↔ "rex-cli" (62+42 crossings) — consider extracting shared interface [warning]
- Hub: packages/rex/src/schema/index.ts is imported by 5 zones — cross-cutting dependency [info]
- Hub: tests/hidden-child-process-alias.mjs is imported by 12 zones — cross-cutting dependency [info]
- Hub: tests/vitest-isolation.mjs is imported by 9 zones — cross-cutting dependency [info]
- Size imbalance: largest zone has 352 files vs smallest with 1 — uneven decomposition [info]
- Fan-in hotspot: packages/web/src/viewer/hooks/index.ts receives calls from 54 files — high-impact module, changes may have wide ripple effects [warning]
- ... and 81 more

### Suggestions

- packages/web/tests/helpers/ contains files from 3 zones (tests-web-helpers, web-server, web-viewer) — consider grouping into subdirectories to clarify architectural boundaries [info]
- Add a convention to PACKAGE_GUIDELINES.md, enforced in architecture-policy.test.js: a module never sits beside a same-named directory (x.ts next to x/). Once a module grows into a directory, its siblings with the same prefix move into it. [info]
- Add language-pack zone pins to .n-dx.json that map packages/lang-<x>/** to 'lang-<x>' and packages/lang-kit/** to 'lang-kit'. Then add a pin-coverage assertion that every packages/* directory resolves to a zone id derived from its package name. This keeps pack zone ids the same between analyses. [info]
- Pack-tier zone ids follow three schemes (lang-*, *-language-pack, language-pack-foundation). Adopt the package directory name as the zone id convention for every packages/lang-* zone, and record it in the lang-kit AGENTS.md next to the pack contract. [info]
- Rename or re-pin the 255-file 'rex-cli' zone. It holds the PRD engine as well as the CLI commands, and the rex→rex-cli majority edge reads as the domain tier depending on CLI code. Pinning packages/rex/src/core/** and src/schema/** to a stable engine id would make the satellite-zone rule ('domain logic belongs in src/core/') checkable from zone edges. [warning]
- Split packages/web/tests/unit into server/ and viewer/ subdirectories (or pin them to separate test zones) so the test zones mirror the runtime server/viewer boundary. One 352-file test zone importing both sides hides test-side imports that cross the boundary. [info]
- Teach the import-graph resolver to map workspace package specifiers through each package.json exports field, and to follow barrel re-exports (export * from / export { x } from), before running the imported-only-by-tests detector. Before: public.ts, index.ts and folder-tree-store.ts are flagged as dead. After: only files with no production path through gateways or barrels are flagged. [warning]
- Hub function: resolveRexPaths in packages/rex/src/store/index.ts is called from 46 files (high fan-in expected for this module type) — changes here have wide impact, consider if responsibilities can be narrowed [info]
- 5 potentially unused exports in packages/core/assistant-assets.js have no incoming calls: getRegistry, getAllSkillBodies, getMcpServer, renderClaudeSkill, renderAllClaudeSkills [warning]
- 5 potentially unused exports in packages/web/src/viewer/components/prd-tree/index-md-sections.ts have no incoming calls: ProgressTable, ChangesList, InfoSection, SummarySection, SubtasksList [warning]
- ... and 57 more
